desc: Derive and verify the aggregate delta for shifting one residue class from value \(M-1\) to \(0\), including duplicate values and an \(O(N+M)\) way to compute all class deltas.
Design an \(O(N\log M)\) method to compute the initial inversion count and required positional/count information.
Formulate the \(O(N+M)\) sweep that updates answers for each successive shift.
Implement the complete Python solution with fast input/output and the requested code delimiters.
